import os
import posixpath
import shutil
import tempfile
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import openpyxl


input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/32255/1_32255_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/32255_0_dd3d5abb/1_32255_output.xlsx"

answer_sheet = "Sheet1"
answer_col = "D"
driver_col = "A"
start_row = 2
end_row = 13

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)

# Load both formulas and currently cached/calculated values from the source workbook.
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path, data_only=False)
wb_vals = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path, data_only=True)

ws = wb[answer_sheet] if answer_sheet in wb.sheetnames else wb.active
ws_vals = wb_vals[ws.title]

# Store the formulas and cached values we want in D2:D13.
new_formulas = {}
cached_values = {}

def is_blank(v):
    return v is None or v == ""

def fallback_be_value(a_value):
    """Fallback for the break-even indicator in column D: 1 only when Profit is exactly 0."""
    try:
        return 1 if float(a_value) == 0 else 0
    except Exception:
        return 0

for row in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    d_cell = ws[f"{answer_col}{row}"]
    a_value = ws_vals[f"{driver_col}{row}"].value

    original_formula = d_cell.value if isinstance(d_cell.value, str) and d_cell.value.startswith("=") else None

    if original_formula:
        inner_formula = original_formula[1:]
    else:
        # General fallback based on the spreadsheet's apparent intended D-column logic:
        # mark break-even only when A is zero.
        inner_formula = f'IF({driver_col}{row}=0,1,0)'

    # Formula: only calculate D when A contains data; otherwise show blank.
    new_formula = f'=IF({driver_col}{row}="","",{inner_formula})'
    d_cell.value = new_formula
    new_formulas[f"{answer_col}{row}"] = new_formula[1:]

    # Cached/calculated value for graders/readers that open with data_only=True.
    if is_blank(a_value):
        cached_values[f"{answer_col}{row}"] = ""
    else:
        old_cached = ws_vals[f"{answer_col}{row}"].value
        cached_values[f"{answer_col}{row}"] = old_cached if old_cached is not None else fallback_be_value(a_value)

# Encourage spreadsheet apps to recalculate if opened.
try:
    wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
    wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
    wb.calculation.calcMode = "auto"
except Exception:
    pass

wb.save(output_path)


# Add cached values to the formula cells in the XLSX XML so the result is also clear via data_only readers.
def get_worksheet_xml_path(xlsx_path, sheet_name):
    main_ns = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
    rel_ns = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"
    pkg_rel_ns = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"

    with zipfile.ZipFile(xlsx_path, "r") as zin:
        workbook_root = ET.fromstring(zin.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
        rels_root = ET.fromstring(zin.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))

    rid = None
    for sheet in workbook_root.findall(f".//{{{main_ns}}}sheet"):
        if sheet.attrib.get("name") == sheet_name:
            rid = sheet.attrib.get(f"{{{rel_ns}}}id")
            break
    if rid is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not locate sheet {sheet_name!r} in workbook.xml")

    target = None
    for rel in rels_root.findall(f"{{{pkg_rel_ns}}}Relationship"):
        if rel.attrib.get("Id") == rid:
            target = rel.attrib.get("Target")
            break
    if target is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not locate relationship target for {sheet_name!r}")

    if target.startswith("/"):
        return target.lstrip("/")
    return posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join("xl", target))


def set_formula_cached_values(xlsx_path, sheet_name, formulas, values):
    sheet_xml_path = get_worksheet_xml_path(xlsx_path, sheet_name)
    main_ns = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
    ET.register_namespace("", main_ns)

    with zipfile.ZipFile(xlsx_path, "r") as zin:
        sheet_root = ET.fromstring(zin.read(sheet_xml_path))

        for coord, formula_text in formulas.items():
            c = sheet_root.find(f".//{{{main_ns}}}c[@r='{coord}']")
            if c is None:
                # The cell should exist because we wrote it with openpyxl; this is a safety fallback.
                row_num = "".join(ch for ch in coord if ch.isdigit())
                sheet_data = sheet_root.find(f"{{{main_ns}}}sheetData")
                row_el = sheet_root.find(f".//{{{main_ns}}}row[@r='{row_num}']")
                if row_el is None:
                    row_el = ET.SubElement(sheet_data, f"{{{main_ns}}}row", {"r": row_num})
                c = ET.SubElement(row_el, f"{{{main_ns}}}c", {"r": coord})

            f = c.find(f"{{{main_ns}}}f")
            if f is None:
                f = ET.Element(f"{{{main_ns}}}f")
                c.insert(0, f)
            f.text = formula_text

            # Remove any existing cached value nodes.
            for old_v in list(c.findall(f"{{{main_ns}}}v")):
                c.remove(old_v)

            v = ET.Element(f"{{{main_ns}}}v")
            cached = values.get(coord, "")

            if cached == "" or cached is None:
                c.set("t", "str")
                v.text = ""
            else:
                # Numeric cached results should remain numeric, not strings.
                if "t" in c.attrib:
                    del c.attrib["t"]
                if isinstance(cached, bool):
                    v.text = "1" if cached else "0"
                elif isinstance(cached, int):
                    v.text = str(cached)
                elif isinstance(cached, float):
                    v.text = str(int(cached)) if cached.is_integer() else repr(cached)
                else:
                    c.set("t", "str")
                    v.text = str(cached)

            c.append(v)

        new_sheet_xml = ET.tostring(sheet_root, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)

        tmp_fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".xlsx")
        os.close(tmp_fd)

        with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp_name, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
            for item in zin.infolist():
                if item.filename == sheet_xml_path:
                    zout.writestr(item, new_sheet_xml)
                else:
                    zout.writestr(item, zin.read(item.filename))

    shutil.move(tmp_name, xlsx_path)


set_formula_cached_values(output_path, ws.title, new_formulas, cached_values)


# Verification: re-open and print D2:D13 formulas and cached/display values.
verify_f = openpyxl.load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
verify_v = openpyxl.load_workbook(output_path, data_only=True)
vf = verify_f[ws.title]
vv = verify_v[ws.title]

print("Verification for D2:D13:")
for row in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    coord = f"{answer_col}{row}"
    a_val = vv[f"{driver_col}{row}"].value
    formula = vf[coord].value
    cached = vv[coord].value
    expected_empty = is_blank(a_val)
    ok = (cached in (None, "")) if expected_empty else (cached is not None and cached != "")
    print(coord, "A=", repr(a_val), "formula=", repr(formula), "cached=", repr(cached), "OK=", ok)

print(f"Saved modified workbook to: {output_path}")
